en: The image depicts an old stone bridge over a river, with a large, fortress-like building and a prominent church tower in the background. Several people are seen washing clothes at the riverbank. The top of the postcard has the word 'CRIKVENICA' in bold red letters, and there is handwritten text as well as printed captions in multiple languages at the bottom, including Croatian and German.
